reserves.name: Digital-asset cash-and-carry strategy
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Spiko SAS and the eurSPKCC strategy counterparties

reserveReview.reviewer: SONG-2 Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: The current eurSPKCC public share-class API exposes one 100% Digital-asset cash-and-carry strategy slice. The exact strategy positions, counterparties, custody, and any Treasury or cash overlay are not published as a current constituent allocation, so the live slice is retained as one bounded protocol-position row rather than preserving an unsupported 80/20 split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Spiko eurSPKCC share-class API snapshot and product documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The strategy category and live weight are known, but the underlying digital assets, counterparties, custody, and internal cash or Treasury overlay are not disclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Spiko exposes the live strategy category but does not publish the current constituent positions or weights needed for tracked dependency mapping.
